custom-checkpoints-enabled.name: Custom Checkpoints
custom-checkpoints-enabled.description: Enable custom checkpoint visuals in practice mode.

checkpoint-outer-color-enabled.name: Enable Outer Color Override
checkpoint-outer-color-enabled.description: Use a custom color for the outer checkpoint.

checkpoint-outer-color.name: Outer Checkpoint Color
checkpoint-outer-color.description: Color of the outer checkpoint ring.

checkpoint-inner-color-enabled.name: Enable Inner Color Override
checkpoint-inner-color-enabled.description: Use a custom color for the inner checkpoint.

checkpoint-inner-color.name: Inner Checkpoint Color
checkpoint-inner-color.description: Color of the inner checkpoint fill.

checkpoint-fade-enabled.name: Fade With Placement Count
checkpoint-fade-enabled.description: Each newly placed checkpoint becomes slightly more transparent.

checkpoint-fade-step.name: Fade Step
checkpoint-fade-step.description: Opacity lost for each additional checkpoint.

checkpoint-fade-min.name: Fade Minimum
checkpoint-fade-min.description: Lowest opacity allowed for later checkpoints.

checkpoint-fadein-duration.name: Fade-In Duration
checkpoint-fadein-duration.description: Duration of fade-in animation in seconds.

checkpoint-sfx-path.name: Checkpoint Place Sound
checkpoint-sfx-path.description: Sound played when placing a checkpoint.

checkpoint-remove-sfx-path.name: Checkpoint Remove Sound
checkpoint-remove-sfx-path.description: Sound played when removing a checkpoint.

checkpoint-limit.name: Checkpoint Limit
checkpoint-limit.description: Maximum number of practice checkpoints. Disabled if unset.

checkpoint-restriction.name: Bypass Placement Restrictions
checkpoint-restriction.description: Ignore the game's checkpoint placement restrictions.

practice-overlay-enabled.name: Practice Overlay
practice-overlay-enabled.description: Show the practice mode HUD overlay.

practice-coins-enabled.name: Practice Coins
practice-coins-enabled.description: Allow coins to be collected in practice mode.

checkpoint-behind-player.name: Render Behind Player
checkpoint-behind-player.description: Render practice checkpoints behind the player.

practice-respawn-time-enabled.name: Custom Respawn Delay
practice-respawn-time-enabled.description: Enable custom respawn delay in practice mode.
